companyDescription: AI GPU / CPU challenger to Nvidia · Instinct MI-series accelerators + EPYC server CPUs · now also acquiring physical-AI/world-model research (Fei-Fei Li's World Labs, $8.2B all-stock, announced Sep 26 2026)
priceNote: Live $519.25 (+0.5%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $188.22-$658.52, ~21% off the high. Market cap ~$848B (mega).
summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026). AMD pulled back ~11% since Sep 29 ($585.94 → $519.25) and ~21% from its high, which pushes consensus ($637.61) to +22.8% — back above the gate. Q3 prints Nov 3. Self-check (mega-cap): +20% just retraces to the late-September level on a strong data-center GPU guide. earnings_beat has no tier-2 penalty. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +10% assumes a ~1-2 month horizon through the print. แนะนำ 5-10% ของ portfolio — Core Holding.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: Scheduled Nov 3 after the close. The read is MI-series data-center GPU ramp, the World Labs integration, and Q4 guide.

risks: Mega-cap: +20% needs a decisive data-center GPU beat-and-raise.
Beta 2.45 and ~47x forward P/E — the sector selloff could extend through the print.
AI-capex sustainability debate (hyperscaler budgets) hits AMD harder than NVDA on any wobble.
World Labs acquisition integration and spend.
Sell-the-news risk seen across AI semis in Aug 2026 (MRVL -10%).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Profitable mega-cap semis, but beta 2.45 and ~47x forward earnings keep it sensitive to yields and AI-capex sentiment.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.
